item.title: Scaling RAG with Hybrid Search: BM25 and Vector Reranking in Production
item.description: In this article, we built and deployed a production hybrid search pipeline combining BM25 and dense retrieval embeddings. We measured precision@k and recall@k benchmarks under 50ms latency constraints. What are the biggest trade-offs between reranking latency and recall?
item.author: Dr. Jane Doe

item.title: LLM Evaluation Frameworks: Benchmarking Faithfulness and Hallucination
item.description: We implemented an observability and evaluation pipeline using RAGAS. Our experiment tested faithfulness across 10,000 cases. Production architecture trade-offs were examined.
